changeSet.author: hellodata
changeSet.comment: De-duplicate resource rows before adding the unique constraint. Concurrent NATS consumers (find-then-insert with no DB uniqueness) could create several rows for the same (api_version, module_type, kind, instance_name); keep the most recently modified one.
changeSet.sql: DELETE FROM resource a USING resource b WHERE a.api_version = b.api_version AND a.module_type = b.module_type AND a.kind = b.kind AND a.instance_name = b.instance_name AND ( COALESCE(a.modified_date, a.created_date) < COALESCE(b.modified_date, b.created_date) OR ( COALESCE(a.modified_date, a.created_date) = COALESCE(b.modified_date, b.created_date) AND a.id < b.id ) );

changeSet.author: hellodata
changeSet.comment: Enforce uniqueness of a published resource identity so concurrent consumers can no longer create duplicates (the loser of a race fails on the constraint and the message is redelivered).
